claim: Brighton Fringe board acts collectively and transparently in governance decisions.
reality: Duncan Lustig-Prean admits that the board minutes regarding Ben Carter’s removal have yet to be written and that he alone will approve and redact the record. This follows a refusal to confirm any audio/video record of the meeting, no confirmation of attendance list, and a failure to disclose legal basis or policy. Duncan’s gatekeeping of records following a safeguarding disclosure indicates rewriting of events after the fact — in breach of trustee obligations.
